abs_lock_up.definition: The moment when a wheel stops turning while the car is still moving.
abs_lock_up.example: The front wheel went into lock-up and the steering went light.

active_ingredient.definition: The substance in the medicine that produces the effect. Every other substance in the pack is only there to help it.
active_ingredient.example: The active ingredient is the same in both packs, only the strength differs.

differential_diagnosis.definition: The clinician's shortlist of possible causes, kept in mind while they examine you and order tests.
differential_diagnosis.example: The doctor said the differential included three possibilities, and explained each one.

dopamine.definition: A brain chemical linked to reward and motivation. People say it loosely; the useful idea is that wanting and liking are different things.
dopamine.example: The video was not even good, but the pull to check again was strong.

elec_electric_current.definition: The flow of electricity, measured in amperes (A).
elec_electric_current.example: The current went back through the earth conductor instead of through the motor.

er_expectation.definition: A belief about what will happen if you say nothing and do nothing about it.
er_expectation.example: Her expectation was that a refusal would come with an alternative.

intel_verbal_reasoning.definition: The ability to follow and build an argument made of words.
intel_verbal_reasoning.example: His verbal reasoning was strong: he checked the contract clause by clause and found the gap.

intelill_overestimation.definition: Rating your ability above what it is.
intelill_overestimation.example: Her overestimation cost her the job she had already won in her head.

plant.definition: To put a seed into the ground and look after it. Planting is a promise to come back.
plant.example: Bình planted the seed on the first of April.
